The joint strengthening mechanism is primarily attributed to the accumulation of abundant edge dislocations within the 5 nm thick interfacial transition regions at B2/ γ , α 2 / γ , and α 2 / B2 phase interfaces.

the presence of nano-structure details within γ -TiAl phase, including nano-twins with a thickness of approximately 10 nm, stacking faults and their interactions, as well as Ni-Co enriched ordered clusters with an average size of 4 – 5 nm, can synergistically enhance joint strength.
